units.source_text: 玲珑而悬直的鼻梁，虽显得有点单薄，但双颊绯红，很有朝气，仿佛在窃窃私语：我在这里呢。

en.t: Her delicate, high, straight nose looked a little thin, but her cheeks were flushed and full of life, as if whispering: I am here.

units.source_text: 那两片美丽而又红润的嘴唇微微闭上时，上面好像闪烁着红光，显得格外润泽。

en.t: When those beautiful, rosy lips were softly closed, a red glow seemed to flicker over them, making them look especially moist.

units.source_text: 那樱桃小口纵然随着歌唱而张大，可是很快又合上，可爱极了，就如同她的身体所具有的魅力一样。

en.t: Even when that tiny cherry mouth opened wide with the song, it quickly closed again, utterly charming, just like the allure of her body.

units.source_text: 在微弯的眉毛下，那双外眼梢既不翘起，也不垂下，简直像有意描直了似的眼睛，如今滴溜溜的，带着几分稚气。

en.t: Beneath her slightly arched eyebrows, the outer corners of her eyes neither tilted upward nor drooped, so straight they seemed deliberately drawn; now they were bright and lively, with a touch of childishness.

units.source_text: 她没有施白粉，都市的艺妓生活却给她留下惨白的肤色，而今天又渗入了山野的色彩，娇嫩得好像新剥开的百合花或是洋葱头的球根；

en.t: She wore no white powder, yet life as a city geisha had left her skin pallid; today, the colors of the mountains and fields had seeped into it, making it tender like a newly peeled lily or onion bulb;

units.source_text: 连脖颈也微微泛起了淡红，显得格外洁净无暇。

en.t: Even her neck was faintly flushed with pale red, making her look especially clean and flawless.
